about_the_game:
Magic is breaking the world – and Mercury’s at the center of it.  
 
Directorate: Novitiate is a third-person action RPG set in an alternate 2006 Los Angeles, where supernatural Syndicates control the city’s shadows and magic bleeds into the cracks of reality.  
 
Step into the role of Kana Luna, aka Mercury — a newly inducted agent of the secretive and all-powerful Directorate. Armed with guns, spells, and a rare power to glimpse the past, Mercury must survive an arcane underworld ruled by occult politics, fractured dimensions, and untold horrors clawing their way back into the world — all while those she loves become targets.  

About the Demo: 

Investigate the disappearance of Commander Nova of the Costa Muerta Syndicate. Your mission begins in a seaside church in Hermosa Beach. Behind its stained-glass windows lies a bloody mystery and a gateway to a realm of nightmares.  
 
Dodge bullets, cast spells, and fight powerful foes as you uncover the secrets of the Syndicates.  
Find Commander Nova before it’s too late. 


Features: 

 

  • Gun Katas & Momentum-Based Combat – Chain gunplay to build Momentum and unleash brutal finishing moves and magical powers.  

  • Tactical Magic System – Use mana-boosting gunfire and items to power destructive AoE attacks, magical grenades, and protective spells like summoned cover or visual distortions.  

  • Psychometry Visions – Uncover fragments of the past and speak with ghostly visions to piece together dark secrets.  

  • Disturbing Lore & Worldbuilding – Reveal the terrible history of the Syndicates and their research while exploring a shattered realm where memory, magic, and mayhem collide.  

  • Boss Battles & Consequences – Face off against two brutal foes and make a decision that alters Nova’s fate — and the strength of your Syndicate.

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages including Violence/Fantasy Violence.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2600X, Intel Core i7-6800K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 5700, NVIDIA GeForce 1080, AMD Radeon RX 6800XT
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600X, Intel Core i5-10600K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2080
